label: rem:descent-to-zero
title: Descent to dimension zero
html: By the descent theorem (Descartes universe), we may restrict our study to dimension-zero manifolds equipped with bundles P and \mathcal{S}. At a point p\in M_0, the substrate parameter q(p)= 1 + \lvert\langle L_\varTheta, F_A^{+}\rangle\rvert(p) (substrate parameter) assigns a specific quantum constant q\in[1,\infty) determined by P and \mathcal{S}. Here \mathcal{S} represents the totality of fermionic matter packed into the fibre at p. The trivial bundle \mathcal{S}=\mathcal{S}_0 corresponds to empty space, where every point's location is exactly known. A non-trivial bundle \mathcal{S} fills spacetime with fermions, entering the regime of the quantum Bring's surface whose underlying geometry is non-commutative (Section).
